job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Optum AI team is focused on delivering AI-ML solutions for the highest impact and business prioritized problems. Across UnitedHealth Group, we are transforming the health care journey through responsible AI/ML innovation that; simplifies operations and reduce administrative burden; improves the member and provider experience; and brings insights and information to clinicians. Driving Responsible use of AI across the enterprise to ensure safe deployment of AI models into practice is a key focus of Optum AI as well as enabling democratization of AI by creating platform capabilities and frameworks for developers across the enterprise.

As artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) solutions continue to evolve, we are committed to assessing and improving our AI/ML practices continuously based on our own learning, industry best practices and regulatory guidance. Our Responsible Use of AI program, which includes the Machine Learning Review Board, supports all ML teams across UnitedHealth Group (UHG) with a holistic, structured, and cross-disciplined review of AI.

In this leadership role, the Senior Director Data Science for the Responsible Use of AI Program (RUAI), you will be collaborating with other data science and AI-ML leaders to develop technical standards for Responsible AI development and evaluation and translate them into action through the implementation of ML model metrics and monitoring tools. You will apply your expertise in reviewing, assessing, and testing AI used across the organization through several workstreams. You will implement a framework for red-teaming and conducting independent assessment and testing of internal AI and support M & A diligence efforts. You will participate in internal AI governance processes by reviewing internal or supplier-provided AI and oversee external/independent assessments of internal AI. As a key leader in the Responsible Use of AI program, you will influence across the enterprise by interacting with data science leaders and functional business executives to educate and advise on key concepts related to responsible use of AI. This role is essential to the company’s success as the RUAI program has increasing requirements for standards based on emerging technology and to meet the increasing market demand.

As the Senior Director, you will drive the implementation and adoption of state-of-the-art evaluation metrics for Generative AI and other modern AI methods as well as drive the frameworks and evaluation process for measuring the safety, accuracy, and fairness of ML model implementation. You will provide leadership to, and will be accountable for, the adoption and consistent use of standardized AI measurement and monitoring frameworks and tools. This role reports to the Director of the Responsible Use of AI Program and working with the UHG Chief AI Officer.

To be successful in this role, you will bring solid analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance innovation and pragmatism to drive the team and solutions forward, possess an educator’s voice to support organizational growth and maturity, and promote a keen passion for learning and continuous improvement based on the latest AI/ML trends and research.

Please note that this role is not intended for professionals performing the following work: less complex analysis on small data sets; rules-based algorithmic or descriptive analytics; development of big data infrastructure.

You’ll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Primary Responsibilities:
• Research and develop new methods to build, test and monitor AI consistent with UHG guiding principles for Responsible Use of AI (quality, explainability, fairness, security, accountability, and continuous improvement)
• Design and build new tools to implement AI performance and fairness testing and monitoring in partnership with legal, compliance, and engineering teams
• Play a key leadership role in the Machine Learning Review Board to provide direct oversight and review of proposed AI from teams across Optum, UHG and UHC (UnitedHealthcare)
• Conduct Red Team/adversarial reviews of AI used by UHC, Optum or UHG
• Identify and manage third party AI assessors (e.g., consultants) as they perform third-party reviews of UHG AI
• Lead AI due diligence in support of M&A efforts
• Manage a small, dedicated team with the ability to utilize development engineers, SMEs, and other resources to achieve goals

You’ll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:
• Master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related STEM discipline
• 12 years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Science, or Analytics with 8 years of experience in AI/ML solution development
• 8 years of expertise in various AI/ML techniques, such as deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, recommender systems, reinforcement learning, large language models, etc.
• 4 years of experience in Python for data analysis and AI/ML development
• 4 years of experience leading and managing (direct reports and dotted line) AI/ML teams including driving projects, from ideation to delivery and evaluation
• 2 years of experience evaluating the performance and fairness of AI following internal or external guidelines for responsible development and use of AI

Preferred Qualifications:
• Ph.D. in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or statistics
• Proven track record of delivering high-impact AI/ML solutions for real-world problems and use cases
• Experience in establishing and enforcing AI/ML best practices, standards, and ethics through development of technical frameworks and tools
• Background in Healthcare (AI)
• Portfolio of AI/ML publications, patents, or awards
• Experience in AI or data governance
• Experience in working with cross-functional and distributed teams in a global and diverse environment
• Experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing AI/ML talent
• All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group’s Telecommuter Policy.

California, Colorado, Connecticut, Hawaii, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Washington, DC or Washington Residents Only: The salary range for this role is $147,300 to $282,800 annually. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. UnitedHealth Group complies with all minimum wage laws as applicable. In addition to your salary, UnitedHealth Group offers benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with UnitedHealth Group, you’ll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives.

Application Deadline: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone–of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income–deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes — an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Zenie is an AI-powered conversational journal and wellness app. Zenie is backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund) and HF0.

Zenie is a space for women to press pause in their day and reflect on how they’re feeling. Say you’re preparing for a first date, job interview, or big presentation at work, you can journal with Zenie to process what you’re going through and get expert advice on how to tackle these challenges head on. Here's what our users have been saying about Zenie: "Zenie is fascinating and such a valuable app. I'm learning about myself and feel like I have a great new outlet.", "I really do enjoy Zenie and use it all the time." Zenie brings the power of AI to women and is available in the App Store.

We believe in building magic with excellence, self-autonomy and accountability, continuous learning, and customer-obsession.

About the role:

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Head of Growth to report directly to the CEO and shape Zenie from 0 to 1.

You will be responsible for building the core growth strategy that brings people to Zenie. Zenie is located in San Francisco and New York; ideally this important role is also based in one of those locations, though we are open to a fully or partially remote position.

Job Overview: As the Head of Growth, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to dramatically increase our user base. You will work closely with the founder and developers to identify opportunities for growth, optimize marketing channels, and drive innovative campaigns that resonate with our target audience. Your role will encompass both high-level strategic planning and hands-on execution.

• Growth Strategy: Develop and implement a comprehensive growth strategy that targets significant increases in user signups.
• Brand Awareness: Enhance brand visibility and awareness through innovative marketing campaigns, partnerships, and PR initiatives.

• Experimentation: Conduct A/B testing and other experiments to refine and enhance marketing strategies.
• Budget Management: Manage the growth marketing budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources to maximize ROI.

• Proven experience in a growth-focused role, preferably in an early-stage startup environment.
• Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, including SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, and content marketing.
• Experience with data analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel) and CRM platforms.
• Demonstrated success in significantly scaling user acquisition and increasing brand awareness.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, results-oriented approach.
• Strong leadership skills and the ability to inspire and motivate a team.
• Customer obsession and interest in working in a fast-paced AI company.

• Opportunity to play a pivotal role in the growth and success of an innovative startup.

• Healthcare, dental, and vision benefits, fully covered for employees
• Hybrid work environment
• Company computer of your choice - Macbook Pro, Dell, etc.

Description

United's Digital Technology team designs, develops, and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.

Our Values: At United Airlines, we believe that inclusion propels innovation and is the foundation of all that we do. Our Shared Purpose: "Connecting people. Uniting the world." drives us to be the best airline for our employees, customers, and everyone we serve, and we can only do that with a truly diverse and inclusive workforce. Our team spans the globe and is made up of diverse individuals all working together with cutting-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation.

With multiple employee-run "Business Resource Group" communities and world-class benefits like health insurance, parental leave, and space available travel, United is truly a one-of-a-kind place to work that will make you feel welcome and accepted. Come join our team and help us make a positive impact on the world.

Job overview and responsibilities

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced individual to deliver disruptive value as Senior Manager of the Generative AI CoE team. This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the strategic direction, oversee research and development activities, and drive innovation in the field of generative artificial intelligence. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in advancing our organization's capabilities and impact in generative AI technologies. Key responsibilities in this role will include (1) guiding the feasibility and development of generative AI use-cases in a consultative capacity across the entire organization (2) leading execution of a subset of complex GenAI use cases (3) overseeing and contributing towards assetization of Gen AI resources (4) scaling innovation in the field of generative AI by driving cutting-edge research and empowering the wider organization through education and outreach.
• Formulating and executing a comprehensive intake process for the Generative AI Center of Excellence
• Lead the execution and ongoing support of high priority, complex GenAI use cases including managing staffing across direct reports, external resourcing, and satellite teams for delivery
• Design and stand up a process for long term GenAI use case and model maintenance and support
• Maintaining close engagement with business leaders and Digital Technology partners across all project phases, fostering high-level relationships
• Recruiting and mentoring elite talent specifically for generative AI, promoting a progressive culture of rapid innovation within the COE
• Continuously updating knowledge on ML/AI research, particularly generative AI developments, to keep the COE at the forefront of innovation
• Advocating for and effectively educating the organization on cutting-edge generative AI approaches derived from scientific research, enhancing the practical applications of AI at United Airlines

United Airlines is an equal opportunity employer. United Airlines recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, physical ability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.
Qualifications

Required
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Economics
• 9+ years of relevant experience
• 7+ years in Data science and Machine learning roles
• Mastery in advanced LLMs (e.g., GPT-3.5, GPT-4, Claude, Falcon, Vicuna) and Gen AI models for content creation, NLP, and Computer Vision including GANs and Diffusion models
• Proficient in prompt engineering, Langchain, LlamaIndex, and understanding of language models and transformers for dynamic LLM interactions
• Solid experience with ML algorithms, NLP techniques, deep learning architectures, and computer vision applications
• Proficiency in Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, and SQL for high-performance, scalable coding
• Competence in vector databases and MLOps practices for AI model efficiency and lifecycle management
• Deep familiarity with AWS/Microsoft Azure services for robust AI deployment and adept at managing AI models in production environments, including designing control and sandboxing systems for AI research
• Analytical skills to define metrics for evaluating AI solutions and problem-solving, coupled with effective communication and collaboration abilities across organizational levels
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
• Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
• Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

Preferred
• Master’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Economics
• Prior experience leading and developing high performing teams with an emphasis on execution and through-put
• Innovative problem-solving ability in a matrix organization, capable of delivering high-quality AI solutions amidst ambiguity
• Familiarity with Explainable AI principles to ensure transparency and understandability of AI models
• Experience in engineering high-performance, large-scale ML systems that demonstrate direct impact
• Profound hands-on experience in developing scalable backend platforms and engineering APIs
• Practical experience in MLOps, including a comprehensive understanding of the CI/CD process for efficient AI model development and deployment

Equal Opportunity Employer - Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled/LGBT

JOB LEVEL
P30

EMPLOYEE ROLE
Individual Contributor

The Opportunity

Join the AI Assistant team as a Product Manager and propel the evolution of Adobe's AI Assistant: a natural language interface which improves efficiency and access across Adobe Experience Platform. Adobe Experience Platform, which sits in Adobe's Experience Cloud, is an industry-leading technology that weaves together customer data in real time.

This role focuses on scaling AI Assistant, enriching feature capabilities, and driving value realization. Ideal for trailblazers in generative AI, you'll lead efforts to expand into new domains and innovate within personalization, discoverability, and insight generation. Dive into a world where your work directly influences the future of how AI helps people do their jobs more efficiently and effectively.

What You'll Do
• Develop and communicate a clear product strategy that aligns with Adobe's goals and objectives.
• Talk with customers on an ongoing basis to maintain a deep understanding of their needs and preferences.
• Be the Voice of the Customer and drive product requirements based on understanding of specific market segments and target customers.
• Build and maintain a clear, actionable roadmap over the next 3, 6, 12 months, and 2 years, focusing on growing features and user base.
• Lead and encourage cross-functional teams, including AI researchers, engineers, designers, and marketers, to build high-quality, customer centric solutions.
• Lead the prototyping and early conceptualization phases for new AI Assistant features and capabilities.
• Drive the development of strategic features by using Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing to improve discoverability, task automation, and insight generation.
• Drive decision-making by presenting concepts, insights, and key findings to executives and leaders.
• Be a leader and subject matter expert for how natural language interfaces will redefine software at Adobe

What You Need to Succeed
• Urgency to find problems worth solving, and agency to build solutions for those problems
• Ability to complete tasks with minimal guidance; think strategically, and work tactically; attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
• Proven experience as a product manager in a software development environment.
• A passion for innovation, and experience with design thinking, lean startup, and other innovation methodologies.
• Enthusiastic curiosity about the latest technology and innovation trends.
• Prior experience of leading, launching, and delivering a service with 360 cross-functional impact.
• Strong data driven analytical abilities to back up assumptions and recommendations, and to deliver exceptional user experiences.

Education/Work Experience
• BS or MS degree in computer science or equivalent technical field is a plus but not required
• AI/ML related background
• 2+ years of product management, engineering management, or consulting experience

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several  U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $97,600 -- $189,600 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC = base + commission), and short-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans. Non-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP).

In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award.

Adobe will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.

Internal Opportunities

Creativity, curiosity, and constant learning are celebrated aspects of your career growth journey. We’re glad that you’re pursuing a new opportunity at Adobe!

Put your best foot forward:

1. Update your Resume/CV and Workday profile – don’t forget to include your uniquely ‘Adobe’ experiences and volunteer work.

2. Visit the Internal Mobility page on Inside Adobe to learn more about the process and set up a job alert for roles you’re interested in.

3. Check out these tips to help you prep for interviews.

4. If you are applying for a role outside of your current country, ensure you review the International Resources for Relocating Employees on Inside Adobe, including the impacts to your Benefits, AIP, Equity & Payroll.

Once you apply for a role via Workday, the Talent Team will reach out to you within 2 weeks. If you move into the official interview process with the hiring team, make sure you inform your manager so they can champion your career growth.

At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.

Adobe is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our internal careers site or to complete the application process, please contact accommodations@adobe.com.

Position:
AI- Supplier Manager, Mgr
Job Description:

Arrow ECS, NA is looking for a world-class AI Supplier Manager, Mgr, to drive cross-vendor solution alignment and growth in the AI business in North America. In this role, you will develop and execute go-to-market AI cross-vendor strategies that enable Arrow partners to build solutions, offerings, and new capabilities that meet the needs of their customers. This is a very exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of this exciting field alongside some of the most innovative companies in the world.

As an AI SME (Subject Matter Expert) Supplier Manager, Mgr, you will build influential relationships with key decision makers at assigned suppliers and ecosystem vendors to grow sales and market share in respective technologies through various programs and marketing communications activities. You will act as a liaison between field selling groups and corporate to resolve questions/ issues regarding products and/or suppliers, including supply chain management, website development, and promotional materials. In this position, you will be expected to be the SME (subject matter expert) within these technologies and provide guidance to the field on large opportunities.

What You'll Be Doing:
• Develop influential supplier relationships with key decision makers, which will allow Arrow to gain a competitive advantage on sales opportunities and advocate for suppliers within Arrow.
• Manage the team to partner with the sales team to enable navigation throughout ECS, drive supplier/technology sales to customers, and position Arrow appropriately with suppliers at both the corporate and local levels.
• Provide direction to the team to identify specific use cases, industry and market segments, and customers. Market-specific suppliers and technologies to the Arrow sales team, with the goal of growing the customer base.
• Drive and work with the team to develop and execute strategies to grow sales/market share with suppliers and/or technologies. Conduct stakeholder management with key constituents in other departments to enable the implementation of strategies.
• Activities include building and executing joint get-to-market and go-to-market plans, educating partners on services, helping partners innovate with our services, and unblocking challenges that our partners face in realizing business growth. You will be responsible for driving top-line revenue, profitability growth, and overall market adoption of partner solutions and capabilities. You will be the cross-vendor AI subject matter expert supporting supplier management and sales teams.
• Implement ease-of-business initiatives with suppliers, including, but not limited to, API's, net transactions, shared backlog files, barcoding, accurate forecasting, sales tools, etc. Coordinate and own supplier reviews, including the resources needed, GRPI model, presentation, and analysis.
• The ideal candidate will have experience driving successful partnership initiatives at scale and a sales or business development background with demonstrated experience driving GTM motions. The ideal candidate possesses a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges and a solid ability to dive deep into data to uncover business opportunities. Presentation skills and sales acumen are a must and a core responsibility of the role. Working knowledge of and experience in the AI category is required.
• Continually assess workloads, gaps in skills, and the need for additional recruiting, hiring, and staffing.
• Generally, top and large supplier lines are assigned to this role/ team.
What We Are Looking For:
• Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience with a 4-year degree, or 8 years and an advanced degree or equivalent experience.
• Previously managed professional employees and/or supervisors or supervises large, complex technical or business support or production operations team(s)
• Execute GTM strategy to grow Arrow AI's cross-vendor business through partners in North America.
• Is accountable for the performance and results of a team within its own discipline or function
• Adapts departmental plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges
• Decisions are guided by policies, procedures, and business plans; receive guidance from senior manager.
• Provides technical guidance to employees, colleagues, and/or customers
• Accountable for the budget, performance, and results of a medium-sized team or multiple small teams
• Drive partner revenue and growth through regular pipeline, opportunity registration, and business reviews with partner leadership to exceed annual goals.
• Engage with supplier management, partner management, field sales, solution architecture, and end customers to create and drive AI revenue opportunities for Arrow.
• Develop and deliver AI cross-vendor solution sales and technical briefings
• Exercises full management authority, including performance reviews, pay decisions, recruitment, discipline, termination, and other personnel actions
• Provide thought leadership to assist in developing AI cross-vendor strategies and programs.
• Addresses issues with impact beyond own team based on knowledge of related disciplines
• Support partners at different development stages, including practice development, offering/solution development, enablement, and leveraging various vendor programs.
• Serve as an AI subject matter expert who advocates for AI vendor capabilities internally and externally.
Work Locations:
• Centennial, CO- will follow a hybrid schedule: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday are required office days for the Panorama Office site; Monday and Friday, work from home.
• Peabody Boston, MA- Will follow a hybrid schedule: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday are required office days for the Peabody office site; Monday and Friday work from home.
• California and Texas- Chicago- Fully Remote- Must be able to travel to an Arrow office location as requested by Arrow leadership.
What's In It For You:

At Arrow, we are driving innovation and choice by offering employees a variety of benefits designed to keep you and your family physically and financially healthy.

Not only do we offer a competitive salary and work-life balance, we also offer benefits to match your needs:
• Base pay plus variable based on sales with an overall OTE of up to $225K
• Some travel will be expected as part of the role.
• Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
• 401k, With Matching Contributions
• Paid Time Off
• Tuition Reimbursement
• Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options
• Growth Opportunities
• Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance
And More!

AEEC is seeking a Principal Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning Scientist with neural networks deep learning experience who will lead a small team of AI scientists in solving AI problems and advancing AI techniques, science and research agendas of AI in one or more areas. The candidate will be responsible for leading and participating in the design, optimization, validation, and maintenance of large-scale machine learning (ML) models specific to AEEC’s use case. This involves data manipulation, data visualization, and programming. The candidate will also be expected to communicate the results of the analyses across different groups.

The candidate must have a consistent track record of successfully architecting and building highly available, low latency systems for high traffic applications, building machine learning and computer vision applications, a deep understanding of common families of models, feature engineering, feature selection and other practical machine learning and computer vision techniques. The candidate must also have a vision and experience to make end-to-end Machine Learning solutions, proven experience working in an environment building and shipping early-stage technologies, and foster a collaborative environment and bring fun to work.

Required Skills:

· Minimum of 10 years work experience with relevant AI, DL, and ML design and build experience

· Experience in the lifecycle of enterprise-class software development

· Expertise and experience in Machine Learning technologies (TensorFlow, Keras, etc.)

· Team leadership skills

· Strong Python programming skills

· Experience conducting machine learning/statistical experiments and manipulating data sets

· Deep understanding and experience of machine learning, and deep learning theory, algorithms, approaches and practice, including probabilistic and statistical learning, graphical models, machine perception, machine comprehension, neural networks, deep learning, computer vision and other machine learning areas

· Hands on and strong programming experience in one or more of the leading AI, machine learning and deep learning open source libraries

· Strong proficiency with computer vision, natural language processing and deep learning

· Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and principles

· Expertise and experience in using or developing AI and machine learning algorithms, such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning and others, to solve applied problems in various disciplines

· Experience developing, training, and evaluating deep-learning models using deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Keras)

· Experience with open source vision packages such as OpenCV

· Familiarity with CUDA and GPU computing

· Strong proficiency with Python, C/C

Education:

· Ph.D. in a quantitative science: Computer Science, Math, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, or relevant program with major in AI, Machine Learning, or Computational Linguistics

Preferred Skills:

· Excellent technical communication skills

· Recognized expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning applications as evidenced by relevant publications or awards

· Track record of research excellence and high quality publications

Job Duties:

· Provide technical leadership in the execution of AEEC’s AI projects

· Lead a small team of AI scientists in solving AI problems and advancing AI techniques, science and research agendas of AI in one or more areas
